admin_settings.partner_logo_hint: Shown on the left of the footer. PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG, up to 2 MB.
admin_settings.header_colors_desc: Choose the colour of the accessible (GOV.UK-style) site header. Leave unset to keep the standard black header, with a line in your community colour (blue if you have not chosen one).
admin_settings.header_bg_color_hint: The main header bar. Use a strong, dark brand colour so the white text stays readable.
admin_settings.header_accent_color_hint: The thin line under the header. Leave blank to match the header background, or your community colour if you have not chosen a background; or pick a contrasting colour such as white.
admin_settings.community_colour_desc: One colour for your community's website: buttons, links, tabs and highlights. It also colours the offers and requests round-up email and volunteer certificates. Until you choose one, the standard colour is used.
admin_settings.community_colour_suggested_hint: Every suggestion is easy to read on a white page.
admin_settings.community_colour_custom_label: Or use your own brand colour
admin_settings.community_colour_custom_hint: Pick a colour or paste a hex code such as #A3195B. It must be dark enough to read as text on a white page.
admin_settings.community_colour_too_light: This colour is too light to read on a white page. Choose a darker shade before saving.
admin_settings.header_logo_desc: Upload a custom logo to show in the site header instead of your community's initials. Leave empty to use the default.
admin_settings.header_logo_hint: Used for light backgrounds. PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG — max 2 MB.
admin_settings.header_logo_dark_hint: Optional. Shown when the viewer uses dark mode. If omitted, the light logo is used everywhere.
admin_settings.community_photo_desc: A photo of your community, such as members together at an event. It appears in one place: the welcome banner at the top of your home page, under the headline and the buttons. Without one, the banner shows the words only.
admin_settings.community_photo_hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 8 MB. A wide photo works best. Location details stored in the photo are removed when it uploads.
admin_settings.community_photo_consent: Only use a photo that everyone in it has agreed to share. Anyone can see your home page, not just members.
admin_settings.community_photo_preview_title: How it looks on your home page
admin_settings.community_photo_preview_note: This is the top of your home page as a visitor sees it. The photo sits under the headline and the buttons, trimmed to a wide shape like this, so check that nothing important is cut off.
admin_settings.community_photo_where_title: Where it will go on your home page
admin_settings.community_photo_where_note: This is the top of your home page as a visitor sees it. The dashed box shows where your photo will go: under the headline and the buttons. Visitors never see the box.
admin_settings.community_photo_preview_hero_off: The welcome banner on your home page is switched off, so the photo does not appear anywhere on your site. Switch the banner back on to show it.
admin_settings.miy_intro: Six short steps make this site look like {{name}}. Do them in any order. Nothing changes for your members until you choose it.
admin_settings.miy_load_failed: We couldn't load your set-up steps. Please reload the page.
admin_settings.miy_all_done: All six are done. {{name}} now looks like itself.
admin_settings.miy_logo_colours_hint: Colours taken from the logo you uploaded, deepened where needed so that words in them can be read. Pick one to use it.
admin_settings.miy_tagline_desc: One short line about your community. Members see it under your community's name on the sign-in page and elsewhere.
admin_settings.miy_tagline_placeholder: For example: Neighbours sharing skills, one hour at a time
admin_settings.miy_themes_desc: Each theme that members browse offers and requests by can have its own picture. The site already guesses one from a theme's name; choosing your own makes the page yours.
admin_settings.miy_themes_count: You have chosen a picture for {{chosen}} of your {{total}} themes.
admin_settings.miy_themes_none: You have no themes yet. Add some, then give each a picture.
admin_settings.miy_notice_desc: A one-line notice across the top of the site: a welcome, an event, a thank-you. Members see it the next time they visit.
admin_settings.miy_card_text: A few short steps make it look like {{name}}: your logo, your colour, a photo and a line about who you are.
admin_settings.miy_moved_title: Looking for your logo, colours or community photo?
admin_settings.miy_moved_text: They are on the Make it yours page, with your tagline, theme pictures, notices and your accessible site's header colour, so everything that makes the site look like your community is in one place.
admin_settings.save_partial: Some settings did not save: {{parts}}. Everything else was saved.
admin_settings.fix_errors_before_saving: Fix the highlighted fields before saving
admin_settings.unsaved_leave_body: You have unsaved changes on this page. If you leave now, they will be lost.
admin_settings.upload_persists_immediately: Uploads and removals apply straight away. They are not part of Save.
admin_settings.upload_persists_on_save: Uploading applies straight away. Removing takes effect when you save.
admin_settings.reg_mode_open_desc: Anyone can create an account. Email verification and approval rules still apply.
admin_settings.reg_mode_invite_desc: Only people with an invitation code or link can create an account.
admin_settings.reg_mode_closed_desc: No new accounts can be created. Existing members can still sign in.
admin_settings.section_related_desc: These have pages of their own. Press a button to go there.
admin_settings.header_logo_both_hint: Shown in the site header. Preview on both backgrounds to check a light or dark logo stays visible.
admin_settings.reg_mode_help: Applies to new sign-ups straight away. Invite codes appear just below when you choose Invite only. For waiting lists and identity checks, press More joining rules.
admin_settings.community_look_hint: A colour, a second colour that goes with it, and how round the corners are, chosen together. You can still change the colour below.
admin_settings.community_look_none_hint: Your colour only, with the standard second colour and corners.
admin_settings.colour_strength_title: How bold should the colour be?
admin_settings.colour_strength_hint: Soft uses gentle tints of your colour. Vivid fills page headers and picture tiles with it, with white writing. Both stay easy to read.
admin_settings.colour_strength_soft_hint: Gentle tints of your colour. This is how the site looks now.
admin_settings.colour_strength_vivid_hint: Page headers and picture tiles filled with your colour, with white writing.
admin_settings.colour_strength_preview_text: This is how the top of a page will look.
admin_settings.about_section_desc: The name, description and contact details that members and visitors see.
admin_settings.community_name_help: Shown across the site, in the browser tab and in emails.
admin_settings.community_description_placeholder: For example: Neighbours in Riverside sharing time and skills.
admin_settings.community_description_help: One or two sentences that say what your community is.
admin_settings.support_email_help: Where people can write to you for help.
admin_settings.contact_phone_help: Optional. Start with + and the country code.
admin_settings.joining_section_desc: Who can join, what new members do before they get in, and when people are signed out.
admin_settings.email_verification_label: New members confirm their email address
admin_settings.email_verification_help: People must press the link we email them before they can use the site.
admin_settings.admin_approval_help: New accounts cannot be used until they have been approved.
admin_settings.platform_team_only_tooltip: Only the platform team can change this.
admin_settings.auto_sign_out_label: Sign people out when they are away
admin_settings.auto_sign_out_help: Members are signed out after this many minutes without activity. Use 0 to switch this off, or any number from 5 to 480. We suggest 120.
admin_settings.auto_sign_out_aria: Minutes before people are signed out
admin_settings.time_credits_section_desc: What a new member starts with, and the most that one transfer can carry.
admin_settings.dates_money_section_desc: Your time zone, how dates and numbers are written, and the currency for prices.
admin_settings.money_currency_help: Used where real money appears, such as marketplace prices. It does not change time credits.
admin_settings.footer_section_desc: The legal line and partner logo at the bottom of every page.
admin_settings.footer_legal_text_help: Shown in the footer and on your legal and about pages. For example, your charity or company number.
admin_settings.partner_logo_link_help: Optional. The website people go to when they press the partner logo.
admin_settings.config_load_failed: We couldn't load the time zone and time credit settings. Everything else on this page is fine.
admin_settings.reg_mode_help_codes: Applies to new sign-ups straight away. Invite codes appear just below when you choose Invite only.

retention.page_subtitle: Configure how long operational data is kept before automatic disposal. Disabled policies retain data indefinitely.
retention.policies_intro: Enable a policy and set its retention window ({{min}}–{{max}} days). Data older than the window is deleted by the nightly enforcement run, and every disposal is logged below.
retention.no_runs: No disposal runs yet. Runs appear here after the nightly enforcement has processed an enabled policy.
retention.type_activity_log_desc: Member and system activity trail (logins, record changes).
retention.type_notifications_desc: In-app bell notifications delivered to members.
retention.type_login_attempts_desc: Successful and failed sign-in attempt records.

retention.type_vol_wellbeing_alerts_desc: Burnout-risk alerts about volunteers. Only resolved or dismissed alerts are purged.
retention.type_vol_safeguarding_incidents_desc: Safeguarding case records. Only resolved or closed cases are purged; check statutory retention duties before enabling.
retention.type_vol_guardian_consents_desc: Guardian consent records for minors, purged this many days after the consent expires.

sso.intro: Members sign in through your organisation's identity provider using OpenID Connect. A button appears on the login and registration pages for each enabled provider.

sso.delete_body: Delete "{{name}}"? Members will no longer be able to sign in with this provider.

sso.field_key_desc: Short unique identifier used in URLs (e.g. coventry). Cannot be changed later.
sso.field_display_name_desc: Shown on the sign-in button, e.g. "Sign in with Coventry City Council".

sso.secret_keep_placeholder: Leave blank to keep the current secret

sso.field_scopes_desc: Space-separated OIDC scopes. Default: openid profile email
sso.field_domains_desc: Comma-separated, e.g. coventry.gov.uk, example.org. Leave empty to allow any domain.
sso.field_auto_provision_desc: Automatically create a member account on first sign-in. When off, only existing members can sign in with SSO.
sso.field_enabled_desc: Show this provider on the login and registration pages.

onboarding.bio_min_length_desc: In characters, from {{min}} to {{max}}. Ten characters is about two words.
onboarding.bio_required: Members must write a few words about themselves
onboarding.bio_required_desc: They cannot finish the welcome steps while "About you" is empty or too short.
onboarding.country_desc: Choose a country to set up its usual safeguarding questions. You can change them afterwards.
onboarding.hide_no_bio: Hide members who have written nothing about themselves
onboarding.hide_no_bio_desc: They appear as soon as they fill in "About you".
onboarding.hide_no_photo: Hide members who have no profile photo
onboarding.hide_no_photo_desc: They appear as soon as they add one.
onboarding.hide_unfinished: Hide members who have not finished the welcome steps
onboarding.hide_unfinished_desc: They appear as soon as they finish.
onboarding.hide_unfinished_off_desc: Not used while the welcome steps are switched off, because nobody could finish them.
onboarding.mode_app_note: The phone app always takes new members through the welcome steps, whichever you choose here.
onboarding.mode_desc: The welcome steps are the short set of screens a new member sees after joining.
onboarding.mode_heading: Who goes through the welcome steps
onboarding.mode_off_desc: New members go straight in. They are not shown the welcome steps or invited to them.
onboarding.mode_optional_desc: New members can use the site straight away. Their dashboard invites them to finish the welcome steps when they are ready.
onboarding.mode_required_desc: New members are taken to the welcome steps when they sign in, and must finish them before they can use the site.
onboarding.no_questions: No questions are switched on, so new members are not shown the safeguarding step.
onboarding.page_description: Choose what new members are shown and asked for when they first sign in.
onboarding.photo_required: Members must add a profile photo
onboarding.photo_required_desc: They cannot finish the welcome steps without one.
onboarding.policy_note: Check the questions against your own safeguarding policy
onboarding.policy_note_desc: The standard questions are a starting point, not legal advice.
onboarding.preset_done_desc: The standard questions for {{country}} are in place.
onboarding.preset_failed: We couldn't set up those questions
onboarding.preset_modal_intro: This puts the standard safeguarding questions for {{country}} in place.
onboarding.preset_modal_other_country: Standard questions from another country's set are switched off, and members' answers to them are withdrawn. A question that a member relies on for protection is kept.
onboarding.preset_modal_own: Questions you wrote yourself are not changed.
onboarding.preset_modal_reset: Standard questions you already have are reset: the standard wording comes back, any you switched off are switched on again, and none stays marked as required.
onboarding.preset_modal_title: Set up the standard questions for {{country}}?
onboarding.safeguarding_desc: The questions new members answer on the safeguarding step. Coordinators manage them in the broker panel.
onboarding.safeguarding_intro: Your own introduction to the safeguarding step
onboarding.safeguarding_intro_desc: Shown at the top of the safeguarding step in place of our standard introduction. Leave it empty to use ours.
onboarding.safeguarding_intro_placeholder: For example: who looks after safeguarding in your community, and how to reach them.
onboarding.safeguarding_must_answer_desc: They cannot skip this step. "None of these apply to me" counts as an answer.
onboarding.safeguarding_no_questions_note: No questions are switched on yet, so this step is not shown to anyone.
onboarding.saved_desc: New members will see your changes from now on.
onboarding.step_confirm_desc: A summary of what the member entered, with the Finish button. Always shown, because it is how members finish.
onboarding.step_profile_desc: A photo, a few words about themselves and, if we do not have it yet, the town they are based in.
onboarding.step_safeguarding_desc: Your community's safeguarding questions. Only shown while at least one question is switched on.
onboarding.step_security_desc: Offers two-step sign-in with an authenticator app. Always optional, and only shown to members who can set it up.
onboarding.step_skills_desc: What they can offer and what they would like help with. Members can always skip it.
onboarding.step_welcome_desc: A greeting with your community's name, logo and tagline, and three reasons to take part.
onboarding.steps_desc: Switch a step off to leave it out. Members see the steps in this order.
onboarding.steps_off_note: The welcome steps are switched off. These settings are kept, and only the phone app uses them until you switch the steps back on.
onboarding.visibility_desc: A hidden member does not appear in the members list, member search, suggestions or @mentions, and other members cannot open their profile. You still see them in the admin panel.
onboarding.welcome_heading_desc: Greet new members in your community's own words.
onboarding.welcome_text_desc: Shown on the first step in place of our standard welcome. Leave it empty to use ours.
onboarding.welcome_text_placeholder: For example: when and where you meet, and who to ask for help.

reg.level_manual_desc: Admin manually reviews and approves identity verification
reg.level_reusable_desc: Use an existing verified identity for re-registration

reg.post_admin_approval_desc: What happens to a member's account after admin approval

reg.tip_change_modes: Changing the registration mode takes effect immediately for new registrations
reg.verification_settings_desc: Configure identity verification requirements for new member registrations
reg.waitlist_info: Members on the waitlist are approved manually by an admin
reg.webhook_desc: The signing secret of the webhook endpoint you registered at the address above.
reg.credentials_remove_confirm: Remove these credentials? This cannot be undone.

reg.webhook_url_label: Webhook address to register with the provider
reg.webhook_url_desc: In your provider dashboard, add this address as a webhook endpoint and paste its signing secret below.
